entities.name: Web3D Consortium
entities.note: The non-profit organization that develops and maintains the X3D standard.

entities.name: X3D
entities.note: The royalty-free open standard for 3D graphics on the Web.

entities.name: X3D 4.0
entities.note: The latest major version of the X3D standard, heavily integrating with HTML5.

entities.name: Medical Working Group
entities.note: A Web3D Consortium workstream focused on medical and molecular visualization.

entities.name: CAD Working Group
entities.note: A workstream dedicated to integrating Computer-Aided Design and Product Lifecycle Management data into X3D.

entities.name: Geospatial Working Group
entities.note: A group focused on representing Earth-based data and digital twins in X3D.

entities.name: Cultural Heritage Working Group
entities.note: A workstream dedicated to the preservation and display of cultural heritage artifacts using X3D.

entities.name: VolumeRendering Component
entities.note: An X3D component that provides nodes for rendering 3D volumetric data.

entities.name: CADGeometry Component
entities.note: An X3D component providing nodes for CAD product structure and assemblies.

entities.name: Geospatial Component
entities.note: An X3D component that enables accurate geographic coordinate systems and terrain.

entities.name: DIS Component
entities.note: An X3D component that implements Distributed Interactive Simulation protocols.

entities.name: Distributed Interactive Simulation
entities.note: A standard for conducting real-time platform-level wargaming across multiple host computers.

entities.name: IEEE 1278
entities.note: The formal IEEE standard designation for Distributed Interactive Simulation.

entities.name: DICOM
entities.note: The international standard to transmit, store, retrieve, print, process, and display medical imaging information.

entities.name: MedicalInterchange Profile
entities.note: An X3D profile designed specifically for the exchange of medical volume and polygonal data.

entities.name: H-Anim
entities.note: An ISO standard for representing humanoids in 3D environments, often used in medical and simulation domains.

entities.name: NIH 3D Print Exchange
entities.note: A repository by the National Institutes of Health that provides 3D models for medical and scientific printing.

entities.name: VolumeData
entities.note: An X3D node that specifies volumetric data for rendering.

entities.name: CADAssembly
entities.note: An X3D node representing an assembly of CAD parts.

entities.name: CADPart
entities.note: An X3D node representing a single, indivisible part in a CAD assembly.

entities.name: GeoLocation
entities.note: An X3D node that specifies a geographic location.

entities.name: GeoElevationGrid
entities.note: An X3D node that defines a height field over a geographic area.

entities.name: EspduTransform
entities.note: An X3D node that handles Entity State Protocol Data Units for network simulation.

entities.name: ReceiverPdu
entities.note: An X3D node that handles Receiver Protocol Data Units in a DIS simulation.

entities.name: Vince Marchetti
entities.note: A key contributor to the X3D CAD Working Group.

entities.name: Nicholas Polys
entities.note: A prominent researcher in Web3D, particularly in medical and volume visualization.

entities.name: Don Brutzman
entities.note: A foundational figure in Web3D, heavily involved in the DIS component and X3D standardization.

entities.name: Kwan-Hee Yoo
entities.note: A researcher and contributor to medical 3D standardization efforts in Korea.

entities.name: Web3D Conference
entities.note: The annual ACM SIGGRAPH conference dedicated to 3D web technologies.

entities.name: X3DOM
entities.note: An open-source JavaScript framework that integrates X3D nodes into HTML5 DOM.

entities.name: X_ITE
entities.note: A WebGL-based X3D player that supports a wide range of X3D components including DIS and VolumeRendering.

entities.name: Castle Game Engine
entities.note: A cross-platform 3D and 2D game engine supporting X3D as its native format.

entities.name: Virginia Tech
entities.note: A university known for its extensive research in Web3D technologies and geospatial visualization.

entities.name: Naval Postgraduate School
entities.note: A US Navy institution heavily involved in the development of X3D simulation and DIS capabilities.

entities.name: Web3D Korea Chapter
entities.note: A regional chapter of the Web3D Consortium that has driven standardization in medical domains.

entities.name: KS X 3280
entities.note: A Korean national standard for medical 3D printing based on X3D.

entities.name: Heritage Together
entities.note: A cultural heritage project utilizing 3D scanning and Web3D technologies.

entities.name: 3D Blacksburg
entities.note: A digital twin and geospatial visualization project of Blacksburg, Virginia.
